consent.title: Cookies and privacy
consent.body: This site only uses the cookies it needs to work. If you agree, we'll also add anonymous usage statistics and external content such as Google Maps. You can change your choice at any time under “Cookie settings” at the bottom of the page.
consent.settingsIntro: Choose which kinds of cookies and external content to allow on this site.
consent.necessaryDesc: Required for the site to work, for example to remember this choice. Always on.
consent.analyticsDesc: Anonymous statistics about how the site is used, so we can improve it.
consent.mediaDesc: Google Maps and videos from external services. These services may set their own cookies.
